us.h: Cleanup begins as Thanksgiving storm outages slowly shrink
us.s: Outages peaked above 900,000 Thursday and were still over 600,000 Friday morning, mostly in Pennsylvania and Missouri. The East Coast saw floods and water rescues, and heavy snow was still forecast for Montana and Wyoming.

us.h: Wall Street posts its best week in over a year
us.s: The S&P 500 rose 1.6% in Friday's shortened session and gained 5.6% for the week, led by AI stocks. The Dow added about 592 points to close near 50,775, rebounding from the prior week's slump.

us.h: Thousands protest power bills, living costs in Puerto Rico
us.s: One of the biggest protests in San Juan since Gov. Jenniffer González took office targeted record electricity rates, now about 34 cents per kWh. Demonstrators blocked a major highway and criticized grid operator Luma Energy.

world.h: EU budget summit collapses without deal on 2028-34 plan
world.s: Leaders failed to bridge splits over Costa's €1.78 trillion proposal, cancelling Friday talks. They meet again Dec. 17-18; a €45 billion Ukraine loan is tied to the outcome.

world.h: Ukraine says Kharkiv counteroffensive retook 14 settlements
world.s: Kyiv says 'Operation Bear Trap' has regained about 200 sq km in northern Kharkiv region, while Zelenskyy rejects a US-floated option to cede Donetsk's fortress belt.

world.h: Saudi Arabia downs Houthi missile aimed at Riyadh
world.s: Saudi air defences intercepted a Houthi cruise missile fired toward the Riyadh region, after Houthi media reported Saudi strikes on Sanaa that they said wounded 13.

world.h: Conservatives sweep Labor from power in Australia's Victoria
world.s: The Liberal-National coalition ended Labor's 12-year rule in Australia's second-most populous state; Jess Wilson, 36, is set to become its first female premier.

world.h: Mexico files formal complaint over DEA cartel tip line
world.s: President Sheinbaum called the DEA's anonymous Sinaloa tip line interference in Mexico's internal affairs, insisting on 'coordination, not subordination' with Washington.

world.h: Serbia's student movement picks chemist for president
world.s: The Student List, which won October's parliamentary vote, nominated Belgrade chemistry professor Radomir Saicic for the Dec. 27 presidential election, pledging rule of law and anti-corruption.

tech.h: Hackers breached Air Force's Cloud One platform, sources say
tech.s: Intruders reached the control plane of the Air Force's flagship cloud, which supports pay, logistics and radar data, prompting a migration pause. The Pentagon says its systems are secure.

tech.h: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secrets, suppliers
tech.s: OpenAI filed suit in California accusing Apple of stealing trade secrets and blocking its access to hardware suppliers, escalating Apple's earlier lawsuit over OpenAI's device work.

tech.h: Black Friday online sales head past $13 billion
tech.s: Adobe tracked $9.7 billion in US online spending by early evening, up 12.8%, and expects $15.1 billion on Cyber Monday, the season's biggest day.

tech.h: FIFA confirms cyberattack exposed personal, business data
tech.s: FIFA said criminals obtained a limited set of personal and business information; a new extortion group claims identity and immigration documents taken from its Microsoft environment.

tech.h: Nikkei says 5.4 million user records leaked
tech.s: Japan's Nikkei said an intrusion into a third-party marketing tool exposed subscriber emails and phone numbers in converted form; it says no payment data was taken.

talking.s: After wind and rain forced it off Thanksgiving, the 100th Macy's parade runs Saturday from 8:30 a.m. to noon ET along its usual Manhattan route. It airs on NBC and Telemundo and streams on Peacock.

talking.h: Black Friday shoppers hunt deals, stock up on essentials
talking.s: Crowds lined up at stores while online spending reached $82.5 billion from Nov. 1 to 22, Adobe says. Shoppers are buying more basics like cleaning products. The NRF expects holiday spending to top $1 trillion.

talking.h: Eagles stun Cowboys, Bills edge Chiefs on Thanksgiving
talking.s: Philadelphia came back from 21 down to beat Dallas 39-38 on a 59-yard field goal after a failed Cowboys fourth-down try. Buffalo beat Kansas City 13-10 on a last-second kick and is now 10-1.

talking.h: Rivalry Saturday: Michigan-Ohio State, Iron Bowl, more
talking.s: College football's rivalry day includes Michigan at Ohio State at noon ET on Fox and Auburn at Alabama at 7:30 on ABC. Playoff and conference-title hopes are riding on several games.

coming.s: Airports are expected to be busier Sunday, one of the busiest days for the trip home after Thanksgiving.

coming.h: Cyber Monday expected to be year's top online day
coming.s: Adobe forecasts about $15.1 billion in U.S. online spending on Cyber Monday, up 6.2%, capping a projected $47.5 billion Cyber Week.
The Labor Department releases its JOLTS job openings and turnover data at 10 a.m. ET.

coming.h: Supreme Court hears AR-15 ban challenges
coming.s: Justices hear arguments on whether bans on semiautomatic rifles in Cook County, Illinois, and Connecticut violate the Second Amendment. Asylum and excessive-fines cases are argued Nov. 30 and Dec. 1.
The Labor Department's monthly employment report, with payrolls and the unemployment rate, comes out at 8:30 a.m. ET.

coming.h: Final SEC Championship Game in Atlanta
coming.s: The last SEC title game kicks off at 4 p.m. ET at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. Conference championship games end because the College Football Playoff is expanding to 24 teams.
